**Observation Log:**

- [TEMPORAL] Session Date: 2023/05/23 (Tue) 09:57
- [ASSISTANT_SAID] The Bridge exercise helps wake up the gluteal muscles, reinforces spinal stabilization, builds endurance and strength in the muscles on the front and back of the core, and is a precursor to doing a proper squat.
- [ASSISTANT_SAID] To perform the Bridge exercise, one should lie on their back with their arms at their side, legs hip-width apart, and feet in a flexed position.
- [USER] Step 3: Put your top foot in front of your bottom foot.
- [USER] Step 4: Find your neutral spine and engage your core to lock it in place.
- [USER] Step 5: Slowly lift your hips off the ground as you bring them forward to form a straight line from foot to shoulders, like a plank. You do this to avoid side bending in the spine.
- [USER] This motion is the same as for the bridge except it is done on your side; in other words, you are bringing your pelvis forward as you come up, going from bent hips to straightened hips so that you don’t bend your spine sideways.
- [USER] Step 6: If you can, raise your upper arm up toward the ceiling with the palm facing forward, and pull that shoulder blade back toward the spine and buttocks as well.
- [USER] Step 7: Hold for five to ten seconds, with ten seconds being the goal.
- [USER] Step 8: Slowly “sit back,” pushing your hips back behind your feet and shoulders as you return to the floor in the starting position.
- [USER] Again, think about the movement of the bridge exercise, only done on your side.
- [USER] Step 9: Do two to five reps on each side, with five being the goal.
- [ASSISTANT_SAID] Troubleshooting for shoulder pain: If your shoulder hurts, make sure you pay attention to Step 1. Is your elbow directly under your shoulder? Did you pull your shoulder blade in toward the spine and down toward your back pocket before lifting up?
- [ASSISTANT_SAID] If you feel you did these motions correctly and your shoulder still hurts, try bracing your shoulder with your upper hand.
- [ASSISTANT_SAID] If it still hurts, move on to one of the following regressions on the next page, and perform these until you build strength in the shoulder. Then try again in a few weeks.
- [ASSISTANT_SAID] Troubleshooting for back pain: If your lower back hurts with this exercise, try finding your neutral spine again. Try performing the exercise with a slightly more flat or rounded back and see if the pain resolves.
